decision.reason: [ev-a907ed2193a8] is a one-line bug fix saying RBAC permissions were added for terminationGracePeriod. It does not say which permission was added, what failed before the fix, or whether operators must do anything. [ev-5aa24b618332] shows only that TerminationGracePeriod is a new NodePool field in 1.0.0. [ev-873cf7661375] lists RBAC changes but does not tie any of them to this fix. The proposed "none", and its claim that upgrading the chart grants the permissions, are not supported by the evidence and could hide a permission-lost case, for example where RBAC is managed outside the chart. To decide, we need the PR #6538 details (the resource and verb added, and what fails without them).
